## Patient retention for primary outcome assessment

Get data
```{r}
# Analysis data
adat <- get_analysis_data()

# Data on MADRS-10 at day 0, 4, 7, 14 and 28
rdt <- adat[f_visit %in% c("day0","day4", "day7", "day14","day28") &
              variable == "madrs" & 
              part == "total10", 
            .SD[1], by = c("ID","f_visit")][, .(ID, f_visit, n_target, state, trt)]

# Ensure exactly one record per individual per visit
stopifnot(nrow(rdt[, .SD[1], .(ID, f_visit)]) == nrow(rdt),
          rdt[, uniqueN(ID)*uniqueN(f_visit)] == nrow(rdt)
          )
```

Compute retention status per individual and visit
```{r}
# Add indicator of MADRS-10 is recorded in window for each follow-up visit
rdt[, measured := ifelse((state == "in_window") | f_visit == "day0", 1, 0)]

# Ensure measured = 1 for all day 0 visits
stopifnot(rdt[f_visit == "day0", unique(measured)] == 1)

# Mark an observation as "retained" if it is itself measured, or if an 
# observation at a later visit for the same ID is measured.
setorder(rdt, ID, -n_target)
rdt[, retained := cummax(measured), by = ID]
setorder(rdt, ID, n_target)
```

Tabulate retention counts by visit and treatment group 
```{r}
# Count patients retained at each visit and treatment group
rcount <- rdt[, .(n_retained = sum(retained)), by = .(trt, f_visit, n_target)]

# Add number of randomized individuals
rcount[, n_randomized := n_retained[f_visit == "day0"], trt]

# Compute percentage retained at each visit
rcount[, pct := 100 * n_retained / n_randomized]

# Add asterix to day 7 label in figure (footnote reference)
rcount[, visit_lab := ifelse(n_target == 7, "7*", n_target)]

# Columns for at risk plot
rcount[, n_visit := n_target]
rcount[, Treatment := trt]

# Make label for "at risk" tabel
rcount[, n := as.character(n_retained)]
rcount[n_visit %in% c(14,28), n := paste0(n_retained, " (", round(pct),"%)")]
```

Save data
```{r}
saveRDS(rcount, file = "02_data_derived/patient_retention.rds")
```


### Make patient retention figure (Full Y-axis)

```{r}
rstep <- mk_retention_plot(dt = rcount)
rtab <- mk_at_risk_plot(rcount)

# Merge step and table plot
rfig <- melt_plots(rstep, rtab, risk_label = "Patients retained:")
rfig
```

Save figure
```{r}
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/patient_retention.pdf", plot = rfig, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/patient_retention.png", plot = rfig, width = 7, height = 5)
```


### Make patient retention figure (Truncated Y-axis)

```{r}
rstep_trunc_y <- mk_retention_plot(dt = rcount,
                                ylimits = c(80, 101))

# Merge step and table plot
rfig_trunc_y <- melt_plots(rstep_trunc_y, rtab, risk_label = "Patients retained:")
rfig_trunc_y
```

Save figure
```{r}
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/patient_retention_trunc_y.pdf", plot = rfig_trunc_y, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/patient_retention_trunc_y.png", plot = rfig_trunc_y, width = 7, height = 5)
```


## Treatment persistence

Get data
```{r}
# Compliance data
pdat <- readRDS("02_data_derived/treatment_compliance_all_rand_id.rds")

# Ensure data on all randomized individuals are in compliance data and
# that there are exactly 8 rows (day 1 to 8) per individual
stopifnot(pdat[, uniqueN(ID)*8] == nrow(pdat),
          pdat[, uniqueN(ID)] == adat[, uniqueN(ID)])
```

Compute treatment persistence status per individual and treatment day. A patient
is considered treatment persistence until date of premature treatment continuation.
```{r}
# Make numeric variable of day since randomization (1 to 8)
pdat[, n_target := as.numeric(d_on_treat - d_day0)]

# Make indicator variable of treatment persistence
pdat[!is.na(d_prem_trt_disc), i_tp := 0]
setorder(pdat, ID, n_target)
pdat[, i_tp := nafill(i_tp, "locf", fill = 1), ID]
```

Add treatment variable
```{r}
pdat[, date := d_day0]
pdat <- add_derived_data(pdat, "trt")
pdat[, date := NULL]
```

Tabulate treatment persistence counts by treatment day and group 
```{r}
# Add variable of number of randomized individuals per arm
pdat[, n_randomized := uniqueN(ID), trt]

# Count patients without premature treatment discontinuation per day and arm
pcount <- pdat[, .(n_tp = sum(i_tp)), by = .(trt, n_target, n_randomized)]

# Delete day 8 (not part of the treatment period) and include day 0 (day of randomization)
pcount[n_target == 8, c("n_target", "n_tp") := list(0, n_randomized)]

# Compute percentage persistent to treatment per visit per arm
pcount[, pct := 100 * n_tp / n_randomized]

# Add asterix to day 7 label in figure (footnote reference)
pcount[, visit_lab := ifelse(n_target == 7, "7*", n_target)]

# Columns for at risk plot
pcount[, n_visit := n_target]
pcount[, Treatment := trt]

# Make label for "at risk" tabel
pcount[, n := as.character(n_tp)]
pcount[n_visit %in% c(7), n := paste0(n_tp, " (", round(pct),"%)")]
```

Save data 
```{r}
saveRDS(pcount, file = "02_data_derived/treatment_persistence.rds")
```


### Make treatment persistence figure (Full Y-axis)

```{r}
pstep <- mk_retention_plot(dt = pcount[n_target != 0],
                           xlimits = c(0, 7.5),
                           ylimits = c(0,108),
                           ylab = "Treatment persistence (%)",
                           legend_pos = c(-4.5, 4.5))

ptab <- mk_at_risk_plot(pcount, xlimits = c(0, 7.5))

# Merge step and table plot
pfig <- melt_plots(pstep, ptab, risk_label = "Persistent patients:")
pfig
```

Save figure
```{r}
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/treatment_persistence.pdf", plot = pfig, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/treatment_persistence.png", plot = pfig, width = 7, height = 5)
```


### Make treatment persistence figure (Truncated Y-axis)

```{r}
pstep_trunc_y <- mk_retention_plot(dt = pcount[n_target != 0],
                                   xlimits = c(0, 7.5),
                                   ylimits = c(pcount[, min(pct, na.rm = TRUE)] - 2, 100.4),
                                   ylab = "Treatment persistence (%)",
                                   legend_pos = c(-0.2, 0.2))

# Merge step and table plot
pfig_trunc_y <- melt_plots(pstep_trunc_y, ptab, risk_label = "Patients retained:")
pfig_trunc_y
```

Save figure
```{r}
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/treatment_persistence_trunc_y.pdf", plot = pfig_trunc_y, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/treatment_persistence_trunc_y.png", plot = pfig_trunc_y, width = 7, height = 5)
```
